prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Pasadena, Texas, and has shoulder injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1323; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you were involved in at an intersection in Pasadena, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just keep my name out of the recording, if that's all right. You already have it on file.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were and what you were doing just before the impact?

A: I was stopped at a red light, first car in my lane. Traffic was backing up behind me and I was waiting for the light to change. I had my foot on the brake and I wasn't looking at my phone or anything like that.

Q: What happened next?

A: All of a sudden there was a hard jolt from behind. My head snapped back and then forward, and my seatbelt locked up across my chest. I didn't see the other vehicle coming at all. I heard the tires squeal just before it hit.

Q: Did you get out of the vehicle at the scene?

A: I did, but I felt stiff and sore almost right away. My right shoulder was throbbing and I couldn't lift my arm much above my waist. I sat on the curb for a while because I was dizzy.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the collision?

A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic that same afternoon. They took X-rays and told me it looked like a strained rotator cuff. I've been doing physical therapy twice a week since then, and I'm still having trouble sleeping on that side.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add about the collision?

A: Only that the driver behind me admitted at the scene that they were distracted. I'd like that noted, and I'm hoping my medical bills get taken care of. I've missed some work because of this.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
